criteria.statement: `thejudge-refinement/SKILL.md`'s `## Reads` names `PRD/work/<slug>/intake/` and says it is read when the folder exists.
`thejudge-refinement/SKILL.md` states intake is evidence and never authority, listing what it may do and what it may not.
`graph-workflow-contract.md` carries the same evidence-not-authority rule, once, as the authority the skill defers to.
Both files state that a document cited by intake is recorded as a citation and not fetched.
The contract states the rule is unenforced and names the `define` gate as what catches an intake claim adopted wholesale.
`graph-run/SKILL.md` is byte-unchanged by this slice: the define-gate trigger in loop step 5 is untouched.
`npm run skills:ai-sync` run and `diff -rq .claude/skills .agents/skills` prints nothing.
Read the rule as an implementer: intake proposing a slug is honored, intake declaring a requirement settled is not. Record the reading.
